properties.name: RemainderPortion
properties.label: Portion, incl % if needed (<accent red>1/3</accent>, <accent red>20%</accent>, etc.)

properties.name: RemainderTrustArticleSection
properties.label: What is the reference in the Will for the administration of this trust? (i.e., <accent red>**Article 4, Section 4.7**</accent>).

formulas.name: RemainderPetitioners
formulas.expression:
["RemainderInTrustTF
   ? (RemainderTrustees|map: {id$: "RemainderTrustee"+this.id$, 
      PetitionerName: this.NameCO,
      PetitionerRole: "trustee",
      PetitionerParish: this.PartyParish,
      PetitionerParishCounty: this.PartyParishCounty,
      PetitionerState: this.PartyState,
      PetitionerGenderHisHer: (this.Gender.HisHer|else: "his or her"),
      PetitionerRelationship: this.PartyDecedentRelate,
      PetitionerBlockAddress: this.PartyBlockAddress})
   : []","!RemainderInTrustTF
   ? {id$: "RemainRecipient"+this.id$, 
      PetitionerName: RemainderRecipient.NameCO,
      PetitionerRole: "individual",
      PetitionerParish: RemainderRecipient.PartyParish,
      PetitionerParishCounty: RemainderRecipient.PartyParishCounty,
      PetitionerState: RemainderRecipient.PartyState,
      PetitionerGenderHisHer: (RemainderRecipient.Gender.HisHer|else: "his or her"),
      PetitionerRelationship: RemainderRecipient.PartyDecedentRelate,
      PetitionerBlockAddress: RemainderRecipient.PartyBlockAddress}
   : null"]
